data.body: GAP NOTE: Story scope includes 'arbiter ruling summary truncation' as a separate concern from the 4096-char payload-size cap on defense_text. Add a 4th test: test_github_pr_arbiter_truncation — Given: defense_json with arbiter_ruling.summary exceeding a separate character limit (TBD by S12 — assume 512 chars as a reasonable default consistent with GitHub comment limits); When: github_defense_store_write called; Then: arbiter_ruling.summary in the posted comment is truncated to the limit. This contract documents to S12 that arbiter_ruling truncation is distinct from defense_text truncation.
